basics.name: Anne Branum-Jiao
basics.title: Data Engineer
basics.summary: Data Engineer with a foundation in biomedical research, specializing in building and maintaining cloud data warehouses for high-volume digital marketing analytics. Experienced in designing dbt-driven data pipelines on Snowflake, architecting semantic layers for self-service business intelligence, and integrating agentic AI into engineering workflows to accelerate development and streamline natural language business analytics queries. Brings analytical rigor from 6+ years in preclinical cancer research and immunology, with proficiency in SQL, Python, Power BI, and modern data stack tooling. MS in Data Science from UT Austin (4.0 GPA).

work.name: Brightfire
work.summary: Built and maintained a Snowflake data warehouse with dbt Cloud for a digital lead generation platform processing millions of daily events.
highlights: Designed a layered dbt architecture (staging → intermediate → mart → metrics) across 100+ models for revenue attribution, business analytics, and operational reporting
Architected Snowflake Semantic Views to give business teams self-service analytics with standardized metrics across revenue, traffic, conversion, and cost
Led migration of legacy Airflow DAGs to dbt, improving maintainability, test coverage, and lineage documentation
Integrated AI agents into data engineering workflows for code review, metric validation, and anomaly detection
Built Power BI dashboards, real-time web performance dashboards, and automated monitoring systems

work.name: Audie L. Murphy VA Hospital/UTHSCSA

highlights: Developed dashboards in Power BI and Tableau for cohort demographics, recruitment, and budget management
Designed publication figures in Adobe Illustrator from R-generated plots and organized figures, legends, and main texts
Assisted in grant writing, experimental design, SOP development, and NIH form submissions
